title: Warm Dense German Sausage Hash
description: A peppery, dense, weeknight German dish featuring pita bread and cure, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: German sausage
ingredients.notes: such as knockwurst or bratwurst, sliced

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced German sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the wok and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potato to the wok and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cubed pita bread to the wok and stir to combine with the sausage and vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the bread is toasted and the mixture is heated through.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the hash to a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
